 GTA 6 launches Thursday and is available for pre-load now: Everything you need to know about the new Rockstar game
 'Grand Theft Auto 6' is the most anticipated game of the year, and it's ready to pre-load on your console. Here's what you need to know to prepare for its November 19 launch.
 Dan Thorp-Lancaster Follow Editor Updated Sat, November 14, 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Updated Sat, November 14, 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC If you buy something through a link in this article, we may earn commission.
 Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. Here's everything you need to know ahead of its launch. (Rockstar) It's taken a little over 13 years, but Grand Theft Auto 6 is nearly here, and preloading starts on November 10 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles. The massive success of its predecessor, GTA 5 , means that GTA 6 is likely to be the biggest game launch of the decade, and Rockstar is showing off more of the world ahead of launch with a set of more than 40 new screenshots . Rockstar isn't going small, either; it recently announced a one-day music festival in Miami featuring artists from the game's soundtrack on Nov. 21.
 If you're thinking about joining in on the frenzy right at launch, we've rounded up everything you need to know to get started.
 When is GTA 6 available? 
 Grand Theft Auto 6 launches globally on November 19, 2026, placing it squarely in the busy holiday shopping season. The game has been delayed a couple of times in the past, but there's no sign of that happening again this close to release.
 Advertisement Advertisement If you pre-order digitally, you'll be able to start playing right at midnight local time on November 19. The initial launch will only feature the single-player story mode, so don't expect to be able to jump into online multiplayer right away.
 What platforms is GTA 6 available on?
 At launch, GTA 6 will only be available for current-generation game consoles. That means you can only play it on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S. While we've seen some other modern games also launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, GTA 6 is skipping them altogether due to the high technical demands of the game's world and systems.
 GTA 6 (PlayStation 5)
 $80 at Amazon GTA 6 (Xbox Series X|S)
 $80 at Amazon How much does GTA 6 cost?
 GTA 6 is a little more expensive than normal new game releases, coming in at $80 for the standard edition. For diehard fans, there's also the Ultimate Edition and a physical Collector's bundle that, weirdly, doesn't include the game. Here's how it breaks down.
 Standard Edition ($79.99): Includes the complete base game with the full single-player campaign. Available both digitally and in physical stores.
 Ultimate Edition ($99.99): Exclusive to digital platforms. Includes the full game, alongside bonus cosmetics, in-game vehicles and property vouchers for online play.
 Collector's bundle ($399.99) : Officially called "Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection," this bundle doesn't include a game code. However, it packs a lot of physical collectibles that GTA fans will enjoy, including a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley sunglasses, a snapback hat and more.
 Advertisement Advertisement There's an important caveat, however, if you're planning to buy a physical copy in stores. The game box doesn't include a disc. Instead, you'll get a digital code that you can redeem on your console's store.
 Are there any pre-order bonuses or collabs?
 Yes! If you pre-order GTA 6 before its November 19 launch, you'll get the Vintage Vice City pack. It includes various retro-inspired Vice City cosmetics, along with an exclusive car, the '55 Vapid Stanier. It also includes one free month of GTA+.
 While it's not a preorder bonus, there are also rumors that Rockstar is collaborating with Travis Scott and Nike to drop a set of Air Force 1 Low '07 RS collection sneakers in three colorways on November 19 to mark the launch of the game. Rockstar already collaborated with French electronic duo Justice on the soundtrack for the game, so it wouldn't be surprising to see other pop culture collabs.
 While it's not quite a collaboration, Xbox is also marking the occasion by giving away a one-of-a-kind Xbox Series X inside of an alligator. Yep, you read that right.
 How big is GTA 6 ?
 GTA 6 takes place in the fictional state of Leonida, which includes Vice City.
 (Rockstar Games) Rockstar has revealed that GTA 6 will require up to 212GB of free space , depending on which console you're playing on. That would make it double the file size of Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption 2 . For reference, the base PlayStation 5 comes with a 825GB storage drive, of which only around 670GB is usable after accounting for the console's system software.
 Advertisement Advertisement GTA 6 is going to be the biggest GTA game yet, encompassing the entire state of Leonida. It's also a fully modern game with high-end assets, physics and more. If you're planning to preload it, start considering what you might want to delete to make space for it now.
 Can you pre-load GTA 6 on your console?
 Thankfully, if you have a slower internet connection, you'll be able to start pre-loading the game a week ahead of launch on November 10, 2026. If you buy the game digitally and have automatic downloads turned on, your console should start loading it once the option is available. If you pre-order a physical box, you'll have to wait until it arrives. However, if you get it early, you should be able to redeem the code and load the game ahead of time.
 Can you play GTA 6 on PC?
 Not at launch. In typical Rockstar fashion, a PC version of GTA 6 is expected to arrive later, though the developer hasn't given an exact release date. However, rumors suggest it could be in the first three months of 2027 . If you're planning to wait for a PC launch, expect some pretty heavy system requirements when it lands.
 Can you play it online?
 GTA 6 Online won't be available at launch, but it's expected to arrive in 2027.
 (Rockstar) GTA Online has been one of the biggest success stories from GTA 5 , and Rockstar will push that into the GTA 6 era as well. But not at launch. Like the PC launch, GTA 6 online doesn't have a release date yet, but it's widely expected to arrive sometime in 2027.
 What should parents know?
 Like past GTA games, GTA 6 is intended for adults. The game is rated M for Mature (17+) by the Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) , which is responsible for rating games in the U.S. "Grand Theft Auto VI is rated M for Mature 17+ by the ESRB with Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. Also includes In-Game Purchases," the organization says.
 Advertisement Advertisement If you're planning to purchase the game for yourself and are concerned about your child gaining access to it, both Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 have parental controls that may help. Each console lets you do things like block games by age rating, require authorization for in-game purchases and restrict online voice and text chat interactions. You can see how to use these settings at the online parental control help pages for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S , respectively.
